basic_details.job_title: VNSGU Professor of Practice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: Not specified in the notification. | In the case of Departments running programmes under AICTE, the qualification and experience norms prescribed for Professor of Practice in the Government of Gujarat Resolution dated 14/10/2024 shall also be kept in view, namely: Ph.D. with 10 years of relevant experience in a large conglomerate; or a Master's degree with 15 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or B.E./B.Tech. with 17 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or Ph.D. / Master's / B.Tech. with a minimum of five (5) patents and 5 years of experience in a start-up. A Ph.D. is desirable for guiding research scholars at the Ph.D. level but is not mandatory for teaching. | Persons who are in the teaching profession — whether serving or retired — are excluded and shall not be engaged as Professor of Practice. Applications from such persons shall be summarily rejected.

salary_details.details: In terms of Ordinance–189, the amount or allowance payable to a Professor of Practice cannot be met from the salary grant received from the State Government. Where required to travel for the work of the University, mileage allowance is payable at rates ranging from ₹ 2.50 per km to ₹ 11.00 per km depending on the conveyance used, or at rates fixed by the State Government for taxis/auto rickshaws.

selection_process: The selection shall be carried out in accordance with the Procedure for Selection of Professor of Practice prescribed in Ordinance–189 and the University Circular dated 15/04/2023.
The Selection Committee for the University shall consist of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or their representative
the Head of the Department concerned
the Dean of the respective Faculty
two subject experts nominated by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor
and one eminent external member (non-academic) nominated by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor. The minimum quorum shall be four members
of whom the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or the representative of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor must be present.
how_to_apply: Visit the official VNSGU website at www.vnsgu.ac.in to access the detailed advertisement and guidelines.
Open the online Google Form link available on the University website.
Fill out the required information in the online application form.
Upload self-attested testimonials, certificates, and supporting documents in PDF format.
Submit the online application form before 30/10/2026 for the first batch, or between the 1st and 20th of subsequent months.
important_instructions: Applications shall be submitted online only through the Google Form. Persons who are in the teaching profession, whether serving or retired, are excluded and applications from them shall be summarily rejected. The initial tenure of engagement shall be for one year, extendable up to three years in all. The position is on a fixed-term basis and confers no right or claim whatsoever to regular appointment. The Professor of Practice engaged shall not be eligible for any service benefits, E.P.F., gratuity, or perks other than the fixed honorarium. Originals shall be produced for verification when called for. Candidates may apply for more than one Department or subject area by indicating the order of preference in the form, with a separate submission for each Department.

content_sections.heading: Professor of Practice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Not specified in the notification. In the case of Departments running programmes under AICTE, the qualification and experience norms prescribed for Professor of Practice in the Government of Gujarat Resolution dated 14/10/2024 shall also be kept in view, namely: Ph.D. with 10 years of relevant experience in a large conglomerate; or a Master's degree with 15 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or B.E./B.Tech. with 17 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or Ph.D. / Master's / B.Tech. with a minimum of five (5) patents and 5 years of experience in a start-up. A Ph.D. is desirable for guiding research scholars at the Ph.D. level but is not mandatory for teaching. Persons who are in the teaching profession — whether serving or retired — are excluded and shall not be engaged as Professor of Practice. Applications from such persons shall be summarily rejected.

rows.qualification_required: Distinguished experts who have made remarkable contributions in their professions in fields such as engineering, science, technology, entrepreneurship, commerce, social sciences, media, literature, fine arts, civil services, armed forces, the legal profession, community development, panchayati raj, rural development, watershed development, water harvesting, organic farming, small green-energy systems, municipal planning, community participation, gender budgeting and planning, inclusive development of tribals and public administration, among others. Such experts must have proven expertise in their specific profession or role with at least fifteen (15) years of service or experience, preferably at a senior level. A formal academic qualification is not considered essential for this position where the candidate has exemplary professional practice in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: Professor of Practice Salary
content_sections.text: In terms of Ordinance–189, the amount or allowance payable to a Professor of Practice cannot be met from the salary grant received from the State Government. Where required to travel for the work of the University, mileage allowance is payable at rates ranging from ₹ 2.50 per km to ₹ 11.00 per km depending on the conveyance used, or at rates fixed by the State Government for taxis/auto rickshaws.

content_sections.heading: Professor of Practice Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Professor of Practice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection shall be carried out in accordance with the Procedure for Selection of Professor of Practice prescribed in Ordinance–189 and the University Circular dated 15/04/2023. The Selection Committee for the University shall consist of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or their representative, the Head of the Department concerned, the Dean of the respective Faculty, two subject experts nominated by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor, and one eminent external member (non-academic) nominated by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor. The minimum quorum shall be four members, of whom the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or the representative of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor must be present.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested testimonials Certificates Supporting documents in PDF format Detailed biodata and a brief write-up about potential contribution

content_sections.text: Applications shall be submitted online only through the Google Form. Persons who are in the teaching profession, whether serving or retired, are excluded and applications from them shall be summarily rejected. The initial tenure of engagement shall be for one year, extendable up to three years in all. The position is on a fixed-term basis and confers no right or claim whatsoever to regular appointment. The Professor of Practice engaged shall not be eligible for any service benefits, E.P.F., gratuity, or perks other than the fixed honorarium. Originals shall be produced for verification when called for. Candidates may apply for more than one Department or subject area by indicating the order of preference in the form, with a separate submission for each Department.

faq.question: Q1. What is VNSGU Professor of Practice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an invitation for applications and nominations from distinguished experts for engagement as Professor of Practice in University Post-Graduate Departments for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for VNSGU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification, but the number of Professors of Practice in the University at any point of time shall not exceed 10% of the total sanctioned posts of all Departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the first batch?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the first batch of applications is 30 October 2026 up to 11:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be distinguished experts with proven expertise in their specific profession or role with at least 15 years of service or experience, preferably at a senior level. Formal academic qualification is not essential for candidates with exemplary professional practice.

faq.question: Q5. Can serving or retired teachers apply for Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: No, persons who are in the teaching profession — whether serving or retired — are excluded and shall not be engaged as Professor of Practice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the honorarium for VNSGU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: The honorarium payable is ₹ 2,000/- per hour.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through the Google Form available on the University website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of engagement?
faq.answer: The initial tenure of engagement is for one year, which may be extended up to three years in all.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification link?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the university website at www.vnsgu.ac.in.
